sampling.point: initial ERef fixed state, step0 only

limits: Only k=0 compares identical E/content state and freshly instantiated Adam; later arms visit different states and cannot diagnose optimizer preconditioning under matched state.
CPU seed41 actions must be bit exact; CPU/GPU bilinear sampling and FP32 reduction may differ within explicitly recorded tolerances.
Five-seed repetition evaluates frozen ROI rewards and box-chart score gradients only, not decoder rollouts, content gradients or new task predictions.
Path sensitivity is finite displacement along actually executed Adam directions, not a complete Jacobian, rank or controllability result.

coordinate_gradient.metric: normalized z coordinates mu=mu0+D*z; D=(Ew,Eh,1,1) frozen; compare covector-gradients D*d/dmu
coordinate_gradient.OPD_direction: -D times analytical mean-gradient of frozen-candidate weighted mixture NLL at exact same E state
coordinate_gradient.finite_step: mu_new=mu0+0.05 D unit(direction_z); no decoder/no GT-selected direction or magnitude
coordinate_gradient.zero_IoU: Report separately: IoU local gradient undefined for diagnostic cosine when norm zero; correction direction remains available
